{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
df.info()
df.head(3)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("\nNumber of duplicate patient_id entries:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for assay_batch unit error
print("\nAssay batch A vs B:", df['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check for treatment arm composition
print("\nArm distribution:", df['arm'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check for sex distribution
print("\nSex distribution:", df['sex'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check for severity distribution
print("\nSeverity distribution:", df['severity'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check if all premises are true
premises_met = {
    'female_better': 'Yes, but this must be tested',
    'treatment_arm_has_both_sexes': (df['arm'] == 'treatment').sum() > 0 and df.loc[df['arm'] == 'treatment', 'sex'].nunique() == 2,
    'severity_confounds_sex_response': True  # per data dictionary
}

premises_met"}
